scope.summary: Implement the Mesh-Push (Liquify) workspace as ONE re-editable StudioLiveFilter kind storing a re-editable mesh on the stack entry (dedup of destructive workspace + live mesh-warp): sub-tools forward-warp, pucker, bloat, twirl (cw/ccw), freeze-mask, thaw-mask, reconstruct/smooth; face-aware mode with parametric eye/nose/mouth/face-shape sliders; shared brush size/pressure/density + preview toggle. GPU-required with real-GPU proof + headless fallback; exposes an equivalent headless typed-data path (mesh points) so a model applies it without on-canvas UI. Operator-visible on-canvas workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Mesh-Push (Liquify) workspace: forward/pucker/bloat/twirl, freeze/thaw, reconstruct/smooth, face-aware sliders, re-editable mesh; GPU proof + headless path; operator-visible
proof_targets: real-GPU liquify render + headless typed-mesh path + Argus workspace
expected_tests: real-GPU: forward/pucker/bloat/twirl warp + freeze/thaw + reconstruct render; headless: mesh applied via typed data (no on-canvas UI) + EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback
argus: Liquify workspace reachable stable author_ids; re-editable mesh stored on stack entry

risk_if_missed: No liquify/mesh-push; destructive-only warp; no headless mesh path.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
